### Added
- `muster.muster.toolsetPresets`: the platform's two toolset presets, forwarded into muster's config. `infrastructure` selects every `MCPServer` labelled `agent-platform.giantswarm.io/tool-group=infrastructure` (the mcp-kubernetes, mcp-capi and mcp-prometheus families, stamped by agent-platform-mcps ≥ 0.9.0); `agent-platform` selects the `agent-platform` label (agent-manager ≥ 0.3.0, model-manager ≥ 0.18.0) plus muster's `core_*` tools — the meta agent's preset. Agents name them as `preset:infrastructure` / `preset:agent-platform` in their `toolset`; muster resolves the label live on every request, so a new manager or infrastructure family joins its preset with no values change. Installations add their own next to them (Helm merges the map). A preset named like a built-in (`read-only`, `none`, `full`) fails the meta render, naming it, instead of failing the muster pod's start out of sight. Documented in [docs/toolset-presets.md](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/blob/main/docs/toolset-presets.md); `make verify-presets` asserts the presets on the muster HelmRelease (both engines), pulls the muster chart at the range floor and renders its ConfigMap from the forwarded values.
### Changed
- `components.muster.versionRange` floors at 5.12.0 (`>=5.12.0 <6.0.0`, was `5.x`): the muster chart version with the `label:` preset rule. An older muster refuses to start on the shipped presets, so the source must resolve a chart that has the rule before the release applies the values that need it. Minor releases keep rolling forward on their own. BOM-pinned installations pin muster at 5.12.0 or later (UPGRADE.md).
- `examples/customer-bom.yaml` is a fresh snapshot of the internal dogfooding track (muster 5.12.0, agent-platform-mcps 0.9.0, agent-manager 0.4.0, model-manager 0.18.0, agentgateway 2.0.7, kagent 0.1.48, klaus-gateway 0.39.0, agent-sandbox 0.2.31, dicebear 0.3.10, valkey 0.1.4, connectivity 3.10.0); the previous pins predated the chart's current line.
